answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 67609 Country: Bangladesh Title: Raising one's hand for dua before Iftar Question: I want to know, can I raise my hand for dua with all fasting people before iftar. Answer ID: 67609 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1060/1039/H=10/1437) You may raise your hands. However it is better for everyone to supplicate individually for himself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
